message.content:
This vertical rectangular editorial illustration features a brown, textured background. At the top, the white word "TEMPO" is printed in a large, serif typeface. Above it, black text reads "IMPOR BAJU BEKAS MERAJALELA" on the left and "PENYEBAR ISLAM SEBELUM WALI SONGO" on the right, separated by a forward slash. Below the main title, the date "13-19 JULI 2015" is visible in small font.

In the center, a white cassette tape with a black label and red stripes is positioned. Black tape from inside the cassette unspools upward to form the words "kriminalisasi" in a cursive script and "~KPK~" in a bold, blocky script below it. The tape loops and swirls around these words.

At the bottom, a paragraph of black text begins with "Transkrip sadapan dugaan kriminalisasi Abraham Samad dan Bambang Widjojanto beredar." A barcode, price "RP 39.500", and other publishing details are in the bottom left corner. A solid red border runs along the left and bottom edges.
